title: Non-ergodic dynamical phase transition via a zero-mode exceptional point in a non-Markov atomic Josephson junction
summary: Open quantum systems typically lose their initial memory due to the environmental decoherence resulting in thermalization. We demonstrate a striking breakdown of this paradigm in a head-to-tail Bose-Josephson junction, which is described by an intrinsically momentum-coupled Caldeira-Leggett model. Through exact non-Markov Langevin simulations, we discover a novel type of non-ergodic dynamical phase transitions into a running state, which has no counterpart in Markov limit.
